verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a Triggers feature that explicitly lets consumers subscribe to event streams surfaced from an upstream service, with Smithery proxying the subscribe call to the server instead of requiring polling. This directly matches the story of subscribing an agent to downstream app events via webhooks/triggers rather than polling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that triggers work reliably in production, and more detail on delivery guarantees or webhook payload handling.
